# eProd.io - Free Online Productivity Tools

> https://www.eprod.io

eProd provides free online tools for productivity, business, and personal use. No signup required for most tools.

## About

eProd is a comprehensive collection of free online utilities including:
- PDF tools (sign, merge, convert, compress, OCR, translate)
- Calculators (financial, trading, conversion, health)
- Generators (content, code, design)
- Converters (file formats, units, data)
- AI-powered tools (summarization, text generation, image analysis)
- Developer tools (regex, API formatters, code helpers)
- Business tools (ROI calculators, marketing analytics)
- Trading tools (position sizing, risk calculators, backtesting)

## Top Tools

### PDF Tools
- Sign PDF: /sign-pdf - Digital signature for PDF documents
- Merge PDF: /merge-pdf - Combine multiple PDFs into one
- PDF to Word: /pdf-to-word - Convert PDF to editable Word document
- Summarize PDF: /summarize-pdf - AI-powered PDF summarization
- Compress PDF: /compress-pdf - Reduce PDF file size

### Calculators
- Age Calculator: /age-calculator - Calculate age from birthdate
- BMI Calculator: /bmi-calculator - Body Mass Index calculator
- Compound Interest Calculator: /compound-interest-calculator
- Win Probability Calculator: /win-probability-calculator
- ROI Calculator: /roi-calculator

### Generators
- YouTube Title Generator: /youtube-title-generator
- Hashtag Generator: /hashtag-generator
- Password Generator: /password-generator
- QR Code Generator: /qr-generate
- Acceptance Criteria Generator: /acceptance-criteria-generator

### Content Tools
- YouTube Title Length Checker: /youtube-title-length-checker - Verify title character limits
- Keyword Density Checker: /keyword-density-checker
- Meta Description Generator: /meta-description-generator
- Text Summarizer: /text-summarizer

### Developer Tools
- Regex Tester: /regex-tester - Test regular expressions
- JSON to CSV: /json-to-csv - Convert JSON to CSV format
- API Response Formatter: /api-response-formatter
- JWT Decoder: /jwt-decoder
- SQL Formatter: /sql-formatter

### Business & Marketing
- CAC Calculator: /cac-calculator - Customer acquisition cost
- ROAS Calculator: /roas-calculator - Return on ad spend
- LTV Calculator: /ltv-calculator - Customer lifetime value
- Ad ROI Calculator: /ad-roi-calculator

### Trading Tools
- Position Size Calculator: /position-size-calculator
- Risk Reward Ratio Calculator: /risk-reward-ratio-calculator
- Forex Position Size Calculator: /forex-position-size-calculator
- Kelly Criterion Calculator: /kelly-criterion-calculator
- Expectancy Calculator: /expectancy-calculator

## Key Features

All tools are:
- Free to use (no payment required for basic features)
- Browser-based (no installation needed)
- Privacy-focused (client-side processing when possible)
- Mobile-friendly (responsive design)

## Use Cases

### For Content Creators
Check YouTube title lengths, generate hashtags, optimize meta descriptions, create content outlines

### For Developers
Format code, test regex patterns, convert data formats, decode tokens, generate documentation

### For Marketers
Calculate marketing metrics (CAC, LTV, ROAS), analyze campaign performance, optimize budgets

### For Traders
Calculate position sizes, analyze risk/reward, track performance, backtest strategies

### For Business
Calculate ROI, analyze financial metrics, plan budgets, generate reports

## API

Most tools work entirely in the browser. Some AI-powered features require authentication.
